title: Good build, but not sure of the aim of this design
text:
Good build, but not sure of the aim of this design. The KORVOS Cutting Board is made of good bamboo material and soft silicone footing for drying. It has stainless steel on one side and bamboo on the other. It also has a notch for hanging. It has a good build quality and has a nice weight.

The bamboo side has a liquid channel, but it doesn't go around the entire board. I suppose with this board being only 15x11, that may be enough.

As far as the stainless side, I'm uncertain when or why I would choose to use it. Metal on metal contact always gives me the willies and no matter how well it's built, there will always be a gap that liquid can get trapped in. So if cutting meat on the stainless side, blood can get trapped in the gap and allow bacteria to propagate. That would be the worst-case-scenario. In a milder case, water being trapped between the metal and bamboo would still encourage mold growth.

One should always use separate cutting boards for meat and vegetables. I ended up using this board for veggies and only on the bamboo side.

I suppose it does make a good presentation platter. You can choose to present your food on the bamboo or have a nice stainless surface to show it off.
